summary: Backend+Frontend verification of Admin Payments server-side pagination refactor and Monthly Program. 11/11 pytest tests pass against GET /api/payments/paginated and /api/payments/months. Frontend smoke covered login, pagination footer (page-size 10/25/50/100, prev/next, indicator), tab switching (Tümü/Gelir/Gider), filter clear, sort order change, and Monthly Program load. Summary cards show server-driven totals and remain identical across tabs. Enrichment fields (student_name/teacher_name/cashbox_name/branch_name) are returned for each row and visible in UI (Türkçe Kasası, Matematik Kasası tags, Öğrenci: ... labels).

issues: One student_payment row shows 'Öğrenci: Bilinmiyor' — the referenced student_id no longer exists in students collection. Not a bug of the refactor (server enrichment returns null and frontend falls back to 'Bilinmiyor'), but worth flagging as a data-integrity hint.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py get_payments_paginated: tab 'all' includes every payment_type (incl. transfers), while summary excludes transfers (total_income/total_expense sum only student_payment vs expense/teacher_payment). This is intentional per spec (Net = Gelir - Gider, transfers neutral) and verified consistent across tabs.

Summary pipeline runs on every page/tab switch. For very large collections consider caching the summary per unique filter signature on the client to reduce DB load, or expose a separate /payments/summary endpoint.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression file /app/backend/tests/test_payments_paginated.py covers paginated payments (default, enrichment, tabs, pagination navigation, page_size clamp 100, sort asc/desc, month filter, summary consistency across tabs, admin auth), /payments/months (YYYY-MM desc), and /monthly-program-detailed timing (<15s). All green.
